findings.title: Loader relocation details are narrower than whole-ELF equality
findings.detail: Old/new ordinary wheel native section payloads differ only in .dynamic and .dynstr. The new output RUNPATH is five bytes longer. Four byte-identical loader tables have shifted addresses: .gnu.version +6; .gnu.version_r, .rela.dyn and .rela.plt +8. Their dynamic pointer tags track those exact section addresses; DT_STRSZ grows by 5. The first read-only PT_LOAD file/memory sizes grow by 8 to the exact end of .rela.plt. ELF header, every other program header, all non-loader payloads, static symbol/string payloads and decoded dynamic symbols are equal. This qualifies the exact loader change; it is not whole-ELF identity.
